Eligibility is not proof of causality. Report only capabilities and constraints supported by your own results. Role-separated evidence contract: peer reports are delivered as full reports, but their cited raw observations are NOT automatically expanded. An ID mentioned inside another report is indirect provenance, not evidence you personally read. Cite only citable_artifact_ids provided for your own output; cite the received report ID instead of unseen underlying observation IDs. Do not claim independent database verification without an actual tool result in your context.
